**algoglyph** is a project in [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md). Its code is written mainly in [TypeScript](@/glossary/typescript.md) (83.8 %), with [Rust](@/glossary/rust.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md) and [HTML](@/glossary/html.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 11 November 2026; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 25 November 2026. It reads “chore(merge): integrate \#6, music analysis measured in sonic-playground”. That places it among the projects active in the last 12 months.

It is built with [p5.js](@/glossary/p5-js.md), [Apache ECharts](@/glossary/apache-echarts.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md) and [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md).

It runs as a live site on [GitHub Pages](@/glossary/github-pages.md): <https://korczis.github.io/algoglyph/>.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/algoglyph).

Related work in [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md): [prismatic-flipperzero](@/work/prismatic-flipperzero.md) (2026), [Oscilla](@/work/oscilla.md) (2026), [maze](@/work/maze.md) (2016) and [maze-rs](@/work/maze-rs.md) (2016).
